facts.why: Set under the ice cream sandwiches it reads as if the sandwiches were her gift. Wikipedia: Frankenstein's monster 'accepts her gift of a stuffed animal to remember her by'. No food is given.
facts.applied_text: Scary German Guy serves the boys pie. Cinnamon apple pie. (dish now 'Last-chance-for-more apple pie with cream')

notes: Garlic pizza: TV Tropes says Horace uses a garlic-heavy pizza slice to scar Dracula, so 'a vampire's face' is true. Treehouse confirmed by TV Tropes (Dracula throws dynamite into their treehouse). Nards, Gill-man, monster test, Wolf Man can not drive a car all verbatim on Wikiquote. Stock place card 'Seated near: The monster test' reads oddly (you can't sit near a test). Front panel is the poster, which is the invite layout's design.

vibe.verdict: The nards, Horace, the pie and the amulet now print, but the soft pink wedding-invite style is the wrong look for a kids' monster club treehouse.
